title: Clear the small database advisor leftovers: private.tz_names search_path, six zz_backup_ tables, three unindexed Hunts foreign keys

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: Supabase advisors 2026-11-16: function_search_path_mutable private.tz_names; no_primary_key on zz_backup_free_human_heroes_20261103, zz_backup_free_human_page_20261030, zz_backup_danieltyack_newworld_20261103, zz_backup_danieltyack_nwblocks_20261103, zz_backup_free_human_blocks_20261030, zz_backup_free_human_pages_20261030; unindexed FKs on hunt_missions, hunt_rule_group_members, hunts. Also noted and left alone: 190 RLS-on-no-policy tables (service-role only), 659 unused indexes (idx_scan=0 is not proof), SEC-POSTGIS-PUBLIC (extensions in public, spatial_ref_sys).

WHY IT MATTERS: Leftover backup tables in public are junk in the database; the search_path is a hygiene warning. Dropping the backups needs Daniel to confirm the Free Human and Daniel Space pages no longer need them.

FIX DIRECTION: One additive migration: set search_path on private.tz_names, add the three FK indexes; drop the six zz_backup_ tables only after Daniel says yes.

2026-11-16 zz_backup half: Daniel answered 2026-11-16 15:01Z: drop the six now, no export. Migration 20270346067000_drop_six_zz_backup_tables.sql (written, NOT yet applied) drops exactly the six tables named above with plain drops, no CASCADE. Live catalog read 2026-11-16 (project azsqfeonabsbmemvddqd): each of the six holds 1 row, 32 to 64 kB, RLS on, and nothing depends on them (no constraint, index, foreign key, policy, trigger, publication, view, or function body). The live database has 19 zz_backup_ tables, not six: the other 13 (seven alli_rae, free_human_20261029, group_event_owner, hof_theme_drafts, house_of_fates_update, temple_home, vanta) each have a primary key, so the advisor never listed them; they stay until Daniel is asked separately. The probe only checks that a migration file drops a zz_backup_ table, so it turns green when this file is in the tree, before the apply and regardless of the tz_names and Hunts index half (migration 20270346065000, PR #5035). Evidence still owed: the apply itself, then a catalog read showing the six are gone.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
